release_notes: Release 1.5.1 - Installer & updater migration-engine fixes (heals stale/incomplete installs). CRITICAL FIX: bootstrap.sql had reserved-word column names (databases, terminal, game, radio, etc. in feature_lists) that made CREATE TABLE fail with 1064 under PDO/strict mode on every fresh install, so base tables were never created and ~107 dependent tables cascaded missing. bootstrap.sql rebuilt as the complete idempotent 231-table base schema wrapped in SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0. migrate.php fixed to run SQL statement-by-statement (PDO cannot multi-statement on MariaDB 11/PHP 8), handle DELIMITER stored procedures, use one connection per file (preserves session vars for PREPARE/EXECUTE), set buffered queries (fixes PDO 2014 crash), and write the migration ledger to the actual target DB (was writing to .env DB_DATABASE). Legacy migrations with fragile AFTER <col> clauses / non-idempotent DROPs / hardcoded DB names made tolerant. Added scripts/verify_install.php + INSTALL_MANIFEST.json: machine-readable post-install verification (required tables, config keys, writable dirs, services, source files, migration ledger). VERIFIED: a fresh install DB now converges to 84/84 migrations (0 failed) + 231 tables; Test server healed from 124 tables to 231 with all admin module pages returning 200; verification 6/6 PASS. Also: icecast2 + nginx enabled, PHP 5.6-8.5 installed on Test.
